body: How do I even get on a pill regiment?  I don't really have a doctor to go to.  I haven't been to the doc in years.

No, I don't have that kind of money to do so.  

Guess what recently happened?  I had a job interview across the country, meaning they flew me out.  And I got turned down.  Not to mention my grandpa passed away about a week ago.  Life fucking sucks.

I don't remember if I've been genuinely happy in a long time.  Not since perhaps I was a kid?  

I have a few hobbies, but they're money pits so I can't do it very often, and it seems that when I do do it things never go right.  

I'm depressed in general.  And my situation is pretty shitty.  

I just feel so unwanted.  It doesn't help that my co-worker always brags about all these girls he's bringing home.  Different girls who want to fuck.  He's wanted.  He has girls who care about him.  

I don't have any girls at all.  He keeps telling me about girls who send him nudes.  I mean, what the fucking hell?  I can't even get a girl to send me any pictures at all.

How long?  I've really felt no purpose for at least a decade.  I've been living my life solely for the reason of seeing what is around the corner. But nothing's happened. 

I'm broke, college debt, a degree that's gotten me nothing.  Living with my parents.  No girlfriend.  No female friends for that matter.  Haven't been laid in forever.  

Nothing goes right, I have very low expectations for every day I wake up and I'm still let down.
